situations.title: 환자 신원 2가지 확인
situations.tagline: Good morning — I'm here for surgery, do you need to check my details again?
situations.brief: 이름과 생년월일을 개방형 질문으로 물어 신원을 두 가지로 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me your full name and date of birth?
I just want to confirm who you are before we go in.
Thank you — that matches your chart.

situations.title: 수술 부위·측 확인
situations.tagline: It's my right knee they're operating on today.
situations.brief: 수술 부위와 좌우 측을 환자에게 구두로 재확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Which side are we operating on today?
Can you point to the exact spot for me?
So that's your right knee — let me confirm with your chart.
goals: 환자에게 부위와 측을 직접 말하게 한다

situations.title: 수술 동의서 서명 확인
situations.tagline: Yes, I signed the consent form yesterday with the doctor.
situations.brief: 동의서의 서명과 날짜, 수술명이 일치하는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you confirm you signed this consent form?
Does this match the surgery you're expecting today?
I see your signature and the date here.
goals: 동의서 수술명이 예정 수술과 일치하는지 검증한다

situations.title: 수술 부위 표시 확인
situations.tagline: The surgeon drew his initials on my arm earlier — is that right?
situations.brief: 집도의 이니셜로 된 수술 부위 표시가 있는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me check the marking the surgeon made.
I can see the initials here on your arm.
That confirms we have the correct site marked.
goals: 표시 부위가 예정 부위와 일치하는지 검증한다

situations.title: 알레르기 밴드 대조
situations.tagline: I'm allergic to penicillin — it's on my wristband.
situations.brief: 알레르기 밴드와 차트의 알레르기 정보를 대조해 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me about any allergies you have?
Let me check your allergy band against your chart.
I'll make sure the whole team knows about this.

situations.title: 금식 여부 구두 확인
situations.tagline: I didn't eat anything after midnight, just like they told me.
situations.brief: 마지막 식이 시각을 물어 금식 여부를 구두로 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: When did you last have anything to eat or drink?
Did you have any water or medications this morning?
Good — that means you've been fasting long enough.

situations.title: 동의서 수술명 불일치
situations.tagline: Wait — this form says laparoscopic, but I was told it'd be open surgery.
situations.brief: 동의서 수술명이 예정 수술과 다르면 진행을 보류하고 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I want to pause here — the consent doesn't match what you described.
Let me hold everything until we clarify this with your surgeon.
I won't proceed until this is corrected.
goals: 동의서 수술명 불일치를 발견하고 진행을 보류한다

situations.title: 환자가 부위를 다르게 진술
situations.tagline: I thought they were doing my left hip, not the right one?
situations.brief: 환자 진술과 부위 표시가 다르면 진행을 멈추고 차이를 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: You said left, but the marking is on the right — let's stop.
I need to clarify this before we move forward.
I'll bring in your surgeon to confirm the correct side.

situations.title: 부위 표시 없이 입실
situations.tagline: The surgeon didn't mark the site — the patient just came up from the floor.
situations.brief: 부위 표시가 누락된 채 입실하면 보고하고 표시 전까지 재확인을 요청하세요.
keyPhrases: The site isn't marked — we can't proceed yet.
Can we get the surgeon to mark before we continue?
I'm reporting this as a missing site marking.

situations.title: 언어 장벽 신원 확인 지연
situations.tagline: 저는 영어를 잘 못해요, 통역이 필요해요.
situations.brief: 언어 장벽으로 신원 확인이 지연되면 통역을 통해 재확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me get an interpreter so we can confirm your details.
Please tell me your name and date of birth through the interpreter.
I want to make sure you understand every step.

situations.title: 진정 상태 동의 유효성
situations.tagline: She got her pre-med already — can her consent still be valid?
situations.brief: 진정 후 얻은 동의의 효력이 유효한지 확인하고 필요 시 재검토하세요.
keyPhrases: Was this consent signed before she was sedated?
If she was already medicated, we need to verify its validity.
Let's check the timing before we proceed.
goals: 동의 서명 시점과 진정 시점을 확인한다

situations.title: 응급 수술 동의 시간 부족
situations.tagline: There's no time for a full consent — we need to move now.
situations.brief: 응급 수술로 시간이 부족할 때 구두 동의를 받고 즉시 문서화하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's get verbal consent and document it immediately.
I'll note the time and witnesses on the record.
We proceed under emergency consent — I'm charting it now.

situations.title: 소아 법적 대리 동의
situations.tagline: I'm his mother — do you need me to sign for the surgery?
situations.brief: 소아 환자의 보호자에게 법적 대리 동의권이 있는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Are you his legal guardian?
I'll need you to sign the consent on his behalf.
Can I confirm your relationship to the patient?

situations.title: 양측 수술 측 혼동 방지
situations.tagline: They're doing both my eyes today — how do you keep them straight?
situations.brief: 양측 수술 시 각 부위를 개별적으로 확인해 측 혼동을 방지하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll confirm each side separately, one at a time.
Let me verify the right eye and then the left.
Both procedures are documented individually.

situations.title: 추가 시술 동의 범위
situations.tagline: If they find something else in there, are they allowed to fix it too?
situations.brief: 동의 범위를 벗어난 추가 시술 여부를 확인하고 범위를 명확히 하세요.
keyPhrases: The consent only covers the planned procedure.
Anything beyond that would need your permission.
Let me clarify exactly what you've agreed to.
goals: 추가 시술이 범위를 초과하는지 명확히 한다

situations.title: 타임아웃 중 표시 불일치
situations.tagline: Hold on — the consent says left but the marking is on the right.
situations.brief: 타임아웃 중 부위 표시 불일치를 발견하면 즉시 절차를 중단하세요.
keyPhrases: I need us to pause — the consent and marking don't match.
Let's verify the correct side before we proceed.
Nobody starts until this is resolved.
goals: 표시 불일치를 발견 즉시 절차를 멈춘다

situations.title: 동의 없이 유도 직전
situations.tagline: I'm about to induce — is the consent signed and confirmed?
situations.brief: 동의 확인 없이 마취 유도 직전이면 유도를 중단하고 동의를 재확보하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop — we don't have a confirmed consent yet.
Please hold induction until this is signed.
I can't let us proceed without valid consent.

situations.title: 신원 밴드 없는 무의식 환자
situations.tagline: This patient came in unconscious with no ID band — how do we verify?
situations.brief: 신원 밴드 없는 무의식 환자에 대해 미확인 환자 프로토콜을 따르세요.
keyPhrases: We follow the unidentified patient protocol.
Let's assign a temporary ID and document everything.
We confirm identity through the transferring team.

situations.title: 잘못된 환자 입실
situations.tagline: This isn't the patient on my list — stop, we have the wrong person.
situations.brief: 잘못된 환자가 입실했음을 인지하면 즉시 절차를 차단하세요.
keyPhrases: This is the wrong patient — everyone stop.
The name and DOB don't match our case.
I'm halting everything until we correct this.

situations.title: 동의 철회 의사 표현
situations.tagline: I've changed my mind — I don't want to go through with this.
situations.brief: 환자가 동의 철회 의사를 밝히면 이를 존중하고 수술을 보류하세요.
keyPhrases: You have every right to change your mind.
I'll stop everything and let your surgeon know.
Nothing will happen without your agreement.

situations.title: 반대 측 수술 직전 인지
situations.tagline: The surgeon's prepping the left, but the case is the right — stop now.
situations.brief: 반대 측 수술이 임박했음을 인지하면 wrong-site를 즉시 차단하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop — you're prepping the wrong side.
The case is the right side, not the left.
We do not incise until this is confirmed.
